According to the text, the 10% Mn-doped LNO released 901.4 J/g, and the 50% Mn-doped LNO released 485.7 J/g. 

To find out how much more heat the 10% Mn-doped LNO released, we need to find the difference between the two values:

901.4 J/g - 485.7 J/g = 415.7 J/g

So the 10% Mn-doped LNO released 415.7 J/g more heat than the 50% Mn-doped LNO in the thermal tests.
